canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Aden Jorar: 18-year-old man, 192 cm (very-tall), sturdy stocky construction with a broad frame and compact proportions, skin value band-5-medium-deep. Face: heart-shaped face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; short rounded nose, wide mouth; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: black, asymmetric-extreme, deliberate accent: dramatic contrasting side length. Wardrobe: draped-robe, specifically a draped robe whose belting and openings keep the body construction legible; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette indigo-sand. Visible personal details: one small nape tattoo; a shallow cheek scar; one wide engraved hair cuff on one side, with no other hair or ear jewelry. Make repair, patina, customization, or a keepsake the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: feet plant evenly while fingertips touch a small personal keepsake. Include a palm-sized map roll only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
